name: Creating Skills
description: Creates, audits, improves, splits, validates, and packages reusable agent skills from prompts, transcripts, research, examples, screenshots, repo notes, and workflow constraints.
invocation_phrases: convert these transcripts into a skill
package this as an AI Wiki skill
write_policy: Prefer staging proposed durable wiki edits into 07_inbound/proposed for human review. Do not mutate 02_wiki pages directly. Reviewed installers may update 04_skills and 03_indexes with backups.
risk: low-by-default; medium when generating scripts or install commands; high only if a generated skill performs deploy, send, delete, credential, billing, or production actions.
